key_findings: LPA-LPA1R signaling in SGCs drives A-fiber demyelination-induced pain via Cx43-mediated SGC coupling and TNF-α/IL-6 release.
LPA1R antagonist Ki16425 and minocycline reduced SGC activation, C-neuron excitability and pain behaviors during active demyelination.
